# Task 9558d6f2: Fill outlined regions, preserve nested objects

In these grids, colored outline rectangles/frames contain blank interiors, and compact 3x3 motifs may occur elsewhere (often as hollow square outlines with a distinct center). Transformations vary per instance and must be inferred from demos, but a recurring rule supported by all four demos is that frame interiors are filled with color 2 or 7 according to the displayed compact motif: the compact motif with a central singleton (a hollow 3x3 with center cell of its outline color) gets its center recolored 7, while the other motif color indicates the fill color 2. Do not assume all interiors receive the same color.

## Strong demonstrated mapping
Across demos, shapes are hollow rectangular outlines whose interior regions are uniformly filled. In demo 4, the inner 2-row×2-column interior of color-9 frame becomes 2; the 1-cell hollow color-3 motif (3x3 outline) has its center changed to 7. Large color-9, color-8 frames, and color-4 frames receive fill 7, 7, and 2 respectively; this shows both frame fill class and miniature motif center coloring may be independently determined by shape/palette roles. Demo 3 similarly has 3x2 interior of frame color 9 → 2, and center singleton cells of hollow motifs colors 4 and 5 become 7; larger frames color 1 and 3 → 2, and frame color 6 → 7. Demo 1 includes color-9 frame interior →7, a hollow color-6 2x2 interior →2, and motif centers for colors 0 and 8 →7. Demo 2: color-8 frame interior →7.

## Critical test result for this task id
Test grid 23×22 solved by filling every enclosed interior of the outline shapes with 2 (large frame outlined 9 at rows 0–5, columns 1–6; outlined 0 at rows 5–8, cols 9–12) or 7 (outlined 1 rows 6–11 cols 15–20; outlined 3 rows 12–18 cols 5–11; small hollow 8 at rows 13–15 cols 16–18 center cell). Small hollow color-5 3×3 motif at rows 18–20 cols 1–3: its center cell becomes 7. Keep all frame borders and background intact. This output was ultimately accepted, though after several earlier mistakes.

## Cautions from failed attempts
- Do not fill frame borders or exterior cells; preserve shape outlines exactly.
- Pay careful attention to color mapping. Multiple frames of different outline colors may fill with different colors. The test's demonstrated accepted result had fills: 9-frame →2; 0-frame →2; 1-frame →2; 3-frame →7; hollow 8 motif center →7; hollow 5 motif center →7. The earlier attempts used 7 for the 9-frame and 1-frame and were wrong.
- Ensure exact grid dimensions and row lengths. One failed submission was invalid because rows were not all exactly 22 cells, so validate before submitting.
- Apply filling only to enclosed interior coordinates, excluding border rows/columns; isolated hollow 3×3 shapes are small frames too, with single center cell recolored.
